overall.summary: Practice Fusion EHR provides a broadly documented native TSV export (single-patient and population) with strong coverage across most EHI domains, but migration teams still face moderate reconstruction risk from missing formal constraints/value sets, no public sample payloads, and uncertain boundaries around payments and some attachment lifecycles.

notableFacts: The public v9 index explicitly states manual export supports both a single patient and an entire patient population in a practice.
The assessed dictionary corpus contains 85 TSV tables and 1165 fields, with patient-superbills.tsv (70 fields) as the largest table.
Core lab coverage is unusually deep, including orders, item-level diagnoses/specimens/answers, results, observations, notes, and linked document references.
Documentation is actively versioned, with nine published versions from 2023-11-27 through 2026-01-12.
The export is vendor-native TSV rather than a FHIR/C-CDA projection path, with GUID-based cross-table linkage fields.
Public docs are accessible without login, but they do not provide sample payload files or a formal PK/FK and value-set specification.
